tips.title: Save your work regularly
tips.body: Always save your file as a backup before starting new operations.

tips.title: Use dynamic preview for immediate feedback
tips.body: Mastercam's solids history tree allows you to see the results of your edits in real-time.

tips.title: Reverse extrude direction for correct orientation
tips.body: Click the Reverse All button before setting the extrude distance to ensure the correct orientation.

tips.title: Set extrude distance to control the thickness
tips.body: Adjust the extrude distance in the function panel to control the thickness of the solid model.

tips.title: Use the Advanced tab for additional options
tips.body: Access advanced settings by clicking the Advanced tab in the function panel.

tips.title: Save intermediate results frequently
tips.body: Save your progress after each major operation to avoid losing work.

tips.title: Use levels for organization
tips.body: Turn on level 4 in the Level Manager to see hidden geometry.

tips.title: Chain geometry for extrusion
tips.body: Chain two new rectangles and click OK in the Chaining dialog box.

tips.title: Select through all for cutting
tips.body: Change the operation to Cut body and select Through all.

tips.title: Use solids tree for editing
tips.body: Edit the model using the solids tree to correct errors or add new features.

tips.title: Regenerate solids operations
tips.body: Press [Alt+E] to turn full geometry back on and then click Regen all.

tips.title: Add chains for cutting operations
tips.body: Click the Add Chains button and chain the inside of the handle.

tips.title: Adjust draft angle for faces
tips.body: Change the draft angle to 10mm when adding draft.

tips.title: Set fillet radius for edges
tips.body: Set the fillet radius to 5mm when adding outside fillets.

tips.title: Reduce fillet radius if warning appears
tips.body: Reduce the fillet's radius to 1mm if a warning about the radius being too large appears.

tips.title: Select bottom face for shelling
tips.body: Select the part's bottom face and click OK in the Solid Selection dialog box.

tips.title: Select faces with a single click, features with a double-click
tips.body: Hold down [Shift] while selecting to pick tangent faces.

tips.title: Rotate geometry using gnomon manipulation mode
tips.body: Switch to gnomon manipulation mode, click the center segment of the blue arc, type -10 and press [Enter] twice.

tips.title: Align features using Snap to AutoCursor positions
tips.body: Switch to geometry manipulation mode, click the right segment of the blue arc, move mouse cursor to hole center.

tips.title: Change reference point for measurements
tips.body: Click the ball on the bottom of the arrow and move it as needed, including snapping to other geometry.

tips.title: Add fillet to part using Push-Pull and edge selection
tips.body: Turn off face selection filter, turn on edge selection filter, select inside edge, create 10mm fillet.
